rationale: Two separate comparisons (provider_specialty, network_status) rather than the composite, as the task asks for each as its own comparison on the claim-level fields. All five requested metrics; denial-rate denominator restricted to adjudicated claims per the portfolio definition, with numerator/denominator recorded per group; min_group_size=30 flags unstable groups. join_check on medical_claims.rendering_npi->providers.provider_npi verifies cardinality and unmatched keys before provider_ranking relies on the directory join (manifest shows many_to_one, 150/150 providers, 0 unmatched of 12845, but the plan verifies rather than assumes). provider_ranking ranks the top 10 rendering providers by claim_count with no eligibility floor, since the task asks for the ten with the most claims. provider_join is omitted: the group comparison uses claim-level specialty/network columns and provider_ranking performs its own directory join, so an extra claims-to-providers merge adds no required output and risks column collisions on network_status. Report prints every rate as numerator/denominator, cites artifacts for every number, and carries synthetic-data, descriptive-only, association-not-causation and small-group caveats.
